evidence_quotes.name_asked_and_used: Rep: 'I'm looking to speak with Holen.' Customer confirms identity and rep uses name 'Hollen' repeatedly throughout: 'Hollen thank you so much for patiently waiting' and 'Hollen, I just got it.'
evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: No recognizable quid pro quo framing present. Rep jumps directly into logistics probing without time-boxing the call or promising a dependable quote.
evidence_quotes.two_concerns_question: Never asked. Rep moves straight into address verification and logistics gathering with no primary concern opener.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No concerns were surfaced by the rep's questioning. One concern emerged organically from the customer ('stairs are a pain in the ass') but rep acknowledged it without probing deeper.
evidence_quotes.active_listening_reflection: No summary reflection of any kind offered.
evidence_quotes.promises_delivered: On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage were never mentioned.
evidence_quotes.closes_the_loop: No permission lead-in and no 'Does that put those to rest?' close attempted.
evidence_quotes.concern_led_opening_and_logistics: Rep did not ask 'What items are you most concerned about?' before probing. Logistics gathering was thorough (addresses, parking, stories, rooms, access concerns, two additional stops, walking distances, packing details, wall-mounted items) but opened on the checklist, not on what mattered to the customer.
evidence_quotes.packing_and_box_count: Rep asked if customer needed packing help and customer clearly stated 'partial packing' for specific rooms. Rep stated 'typically bax count based on your home size is twenty about 95 to 115 boxes' and customer responded with his own estimate ('closer to a two bedroom house'). Both items addressed.
evidence_quotes.value_days: Not applicable — call routed to walkthrough before pricing discussion.
evidence_quotes.rate_lock_then_ask: Not applicable — call routed to walkthrough before ask.

top_strength: Rep gathered comprehensive logistics details across all three locations (origin, storage, final apartment) including addresses, dimensions, floor numbers, and walking distances, setting up an accurate virtual walkthrough.
coaching_note: Lead with the customer's concerns, not your checklist: ask 'What items are you most concerned about?' before probing logistics, and deliver the Two Promises (On-Time Guarantee and No Worries Damage Coverage) early to answer the concerns they name, before routing to walkthrough.
